name: Dead Wave Island
summary:
Welcome to Dead Wave VR, an open-world zombie survival experience currently in its Alpha development phase.
What was once a serene Mesoamerican island paradise has become a desperate struggle for survival. Surrounded by infected tourists and locals, your main goal is simple: survive and find a way off the island.
Key Features:
Explore the Island: Navigate tropical beaches, dense jungles, and abandoned resorts.
